Profile Levacetylmethadol, a diphenylheptane derivative, is a long-act- ing opioid analgesic (p.104); it is a derivative of methadone (p.84). It was used as the hydrochloride in the management of opioid dependence. However, the proarrhythmic effects led to its withdrawal in the EU and the USA.
